Show an unprivileged party who gets a wallet holding Verifier balances to execute a `Request` - a nonce replayed across the `old` / `current` window rotation, a `RequestMessage` re-encoded so `proof` still verifies, a `no-sign` or extension path reachable without authorisation, or an `AuthorizationResolution` accepted for the wrong `signer_id`. Binding: every `NearAction` a wallet executes == one its owner signed, for this chain and this account, exactly once.'

Binding: every `NearAction` a wallet executes == one its owner signed, for this chain and this account, exactly once.'
